'''Dr. José Rodolfo Galvele''' (March 10, 1937 – July 31, 2011<ref>{{cite web |url=http://servicios.lanacion.com.ar/edicion-impresa/avisos-funebres/resultado/categorias=1041,1038,1037,1036,1039,1035,1042,1040-fecha=20110801-pagina=1-palabra=galvele |title=José R. Galvele |author=La Nacion|access-date=29 July 2011}}</ref>) was an [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[chemist]].

His research focus was on the mechanism of intergranular corrosion of aluminum-copper alloys and on the pitting of metals.<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Galvele | first1 = J. R. | title = Transport Processes and the Mechanism of Pitting of Metals | doi = 10.1149/1.2132857 | journal = Journal of the Electrochemical Society | volume = 123 | issue = 4 | pages = 464–474 | year = 1976 | bibcode = 1976JElS..123..464G }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Galvele | first1 = J. R. | last2 = De De Micheli | first2 = S. M. | doi = 10.1016/S0010-938X(70)80003-8 | title = Mechanism of intergranular corrosion of Al-Cu alloys | journal = Corrosion Science | volume = 10 | issue = 11 | pages = 795 | year = 1970 | bibcode = 1970Corro..10..795G }}</ref> He proposed a mechanism of stress corrosion cracking <ref>{{cite journal |last1=Galvele |first1=José Rodolfo |year=1993 |title=Surface mobility mechanism of stress-corrosion cracking |journal=Corrosion Science  |volume=35 |issue=1–4 |pages=419–434 |publisher=ELSEVIER |doi=10.1016/0010-938X(93)90175-G |bibcode=1993Corro..35..419G |doi-access=free }}</ref>

He was awarded the Konex award in 2003.<ref name=konex />

Galvele was the first dean of [[Instituto Sabato]] from 1993 to 2007.<ref name=Example2006>{{Cite journal | doi = 10.1016/j.corsci.2011.09.015 | title = In memoriam: Professor Jose R. Galvele 1937–2011 | journal = Corrosion Science | volume = 55 | page = 416| year = 2012 | doi-access = free | bibcode = 2012Corro..55..416. }}</ref>
